title: Police firearm wounded officer
article: The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) team investigating the June 22 shooting at a Lindsay has determined that at least one of the injuries suffered by Peterborough Lakefield police constable was caused by a police firearm.

The SIU has determined that there are six Kawartha Lakes officers and two officers from Peterborough who are considered witness officers and four officers from the Peterborough who have been designated subject officers

The SIU is looking not only into the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Const. Calderwood but also the factors that led to the firearm death of a 21-year-old man, who has been identified as Corey Aaron Armstrong of Morningside Avenue, Toronto, during the execution of a warrant at the residence on Georgian Street.
That investigation is ongoing. To date, no witness or subject officer designations have been made.
Anyone with information regarding the shooting is is urged to contact the SIU at 1-800-787-8529, ext. 1957.
Meanwhile, Const. Calderwood remains in stable condition, recovering from two gunshot wounds at Toronto's St. Michael's Hospital.
